story: By 1367 Zhu Yuanzhang controlled the Yangtze valley. He sent his generals Xu Da and Chang Yuchun north with a proclamation calling on the people to expel the Mongols and restore Chinese rule. On the first day of the lunar year 1368 he declared himself emperor in Nanjing, naming his dynasty Ming, 'Bright', and his reign Hongwu, 'Vast Military Power'.

That summer Xu Da's army reached Dadu. The last Yuan emperor, Toghon Temür, fled north to Shangdu without a fight, and the Mongol court continued on the steppe as the Northern Yuan. Hongwu, who had grown up a starving peasant, ruled with great energy and suspicion. He cut taxes, resettled farmers on abandoned land and kept tight personal control of the government.
story_zh: 到1367年，朱元璋已经控制了长江流域。他派徐达、常遇春率军北伐，并发布檄文，号召百姓驱逐蒙古统治者。1368年正月初一，朱元璋在南京称帝，国号大明，年号洪武。
同年夏天，徐达的大军逼近大都。元顺帝妥懽帖睦尔不战而逃，北走上都，蒙古朝廷退回草原，史称北元。朱元璋出身饥寒交迫的农家，治国勤勉而多疑。他减轻赋税，招民垦荒，把朝政大权牢牢握在自己手中。
ming-founded.why: The Ming restored native Chinese rule for nearly three centuries, and Hongwu's harsh, centralized system shaped how China was governed until 1912.
ming-founded.why_zh: 明朝恢复了汉人的统治，延续近三百年。朱元璋建立的高度集权的制度，深刻影响了此后直到1912年的中国政治。

quote.zh: 驱逐胡虏，恢复中华，立纲陈纪，救济斯民。
quote.en: Drive out the barbarians, restore China, establish order and relieve the people.
quote.from: Proclamation to the Central Plains, 1367 朱元璋《谕中原檄》

story: Hu Weiyong was a long-time follower of Zhu Yuanzhang and became chancellor, the head of the central Secretariat. He gathered great power, and the emperor grew suspicious. In 1380 Hu was accused of plotting a rebellion and executed along with many of his associates.

Hongwu then abolished the Secretariat and the post of chancellor, and ordered that no one should ever propose restoring it. The six ministries now reported directly to the emperor, who read hundreds of documents a day. The investigation of 'Hu's party' went on for more than a decade. In 1390 even the elderly Li Shanchang, the founder's chief adviser, was forced to kill himself. In all, about 30,000 people are said to have died.
story_zh: 胡惟庸是朱元璋的老部下，官至丞相，统领中书省。他大权在握，引起皇帝猜忌。1380年，胡惟庸被指控谋反，与大批同党一起被处死。
朱元璋随即废除中书省和丞相，并规定后世子孙不许再提设立丞相，六部直接对皇帝负责，皇帝每天要亲自批阅几百份奏章。追查"胡党"的行动持续了十多年，1390年连年迈的开国元勋李善长也被迫自尽。据说前后被杀的有三万多人。
hu-weiyong.why: Abolishing the chancellor concentrated all power in the emperor. Later Ming emperors relied on grand secretaries and eunuchs to cope with the work.
hu-weiyong.why_zh: 废除丞相使权力完全集中于皇帝一身。后来的明朝皇帝只好依靠内阁大学士和宦官来处理政务。

story: The Hongwu Emperor had made his sons princes with armies on the frontiers. When he died in 1398, the throne passed to his grandson, the Jianwen Emperor. Advised by Confucian scholars, the young emperor began to strip his uncles of their power. Several princes were arrested or killed themselves.

Zhu Di, the Prince of Yan, held Beiping (Beijing) and commanded strong frontier troops. In 1399 he rebelled, saying he was rescuing the emperor from evil advisers. After three years of war he marched south in 1402, and a general opened Nanjing's gates to him. The palace burned, and Jianwen's fate was never known. The scholar Fang Xiaoru refused to write Zhu Di's accession edict and was executed with hundreds of his relatives and students.
story_zh: 明太祖把儿子们封为藩王，镇守边疆，各自掌兵。1398年太祖去世，皇孙即位，就是建文帝。年轻的建文帝听从儒臣的建议开始削藩，几位藩王或被抓、或自杀。
燕王朱棣坐镇北平（今北京），手握边防精兵。1399年他以"清君侧"为名起兵。经过三年交战，1402年燕军南下，守将打开南京城门迎降。宫中起火，建文帝从此下落不明。大儒方孝孺拒绝为朱棣起草即位诏书，被处死，亲族和门生数百人受到牵连。
jingnan.why: Zhu Di became the Yongle Emperor, one of the most active rulers in Chinese history. His victory moved the center of power north to Beijing.
jingnan.why_zh: 朱棣即位为永乐帝，成为中国历史上最有作为的皇帝之一。他的胜利也使政治中心北移到北京。

people.name: Zhu Di
people.role: Prince of Yan, later Yongle Emperor

story: Zheng He was born into a Muslim family in Yunnan, captured as a boy by Ming armies and made a eunuch in the household of Zhu Di. He became one of the new emperor's most trusted servants. In 1405 Yongle put him in command of a huge fleet, with dozens of large 'treasure ships' and about 27,000 men.

The first voyage sailed through Southeast Asia to Calicut in India. Over the next 28 years there were seven voyages in all. They reached Hormuz in the Persian Gulf, Aden, Mecca by a side mission, and Mogadishu and Malindi in East Africa. The fleets carried silk and porcelain, brought back envoys, spices and even a giraffe, and fought pirates and local rulers who resisted. Zheng He died on the last voyage in 1433.
story_zh: 郑和出生在云南一个穆斯林家庭，幼年被明军俘虏，后来成为燕王朱棣府中的宦官，深得信任。1405年，永乐帝命他率领一支庞大的船队出海，其中有几十艘大型"宝船"，随行人员约两万七千人。
第一次远航经东南亚到达印度的古里。此后二十八年间，船队共出海七次，到过波斯湾的忽鲁谟斯、阿拉伯半岛的阿丹，还派分队去了麦加，最远到达东非的木骨都束和麻林。船队载着丝绸和瓷器，带回各国使节、香料，甚至还有长颈鹿，也曾与海盗和抗拒的当地势力交战。1433年，郑和在最后一次远航途中去世。
zheng-he.why: The voyages showed the Ming's power at sea, but the court ended them. China stayed away from long-distance naval expeditions just as Europe began its own.
zheng-he.why_zh: 郑和下西洋展示了明朝的海上实力，但朝廷后来停止了远航。恰在欧洲开始大航海时，中国退出了远洋。

story: In 1403 the Yongle Emperor ordered his scholars to collect everything written on the classics, history, philosophy, literature, astronomy, medicine, farming and more into one work. The first version was judged too thin. A larger team under Xie Jin and others, with more than 2,000 scholars and copyists, then worked in Nanjing.

The encyclopedia was finished in 1408. It had 22,877 chapters bound in more than 11,000 volumes, with some 370 million characters, copying whole texts rather than summaries. It was too large to print, so it existed only in manuscript. A second copy was made in the 1560s. The original was lost, and most of the copy was destroyed in wars and fires, especially in 1860 and 1900. Only about 400 volumes survive.
story_zh: 1403年，永乐帝命学者把经史子集、天文地理、医药农桑等各类书籍汇编成一部大书。初稿被认为过于简略，于是由解缙等人主持，组织两千多名学者和抄写人员在南京重新编纂。
全书于1408年完成，共二万二千八百七十七卷，装成一万一千多册，约三亿七千万字，而且大多照录原书全文，而不只是摘要。由于篇幅太大，无法刊印，只有手抄本。16世纪60年代又抄录了一部副本。正本早已下落不明，副本也在战火中大量损毁，尤其是1860年和1900年两次劫难，如今只剩下约四百册。
yongle-encyclopedia.why: The encyclopedia preserved hundreds of books that are otherwise lost, and remained the world's largest general encyclopedia until the 21st century.
yongle-encyclopedia.why_zh: 《永乐大典》保存了数百种失传的古籍，直到21世纪以前一直是世界上规模最大的综合性百科全书。

story: The Yongle Emperor had seized the throne by force and feared that officials still loyal to his nephew were plotting against him. He already used the Embroidered Uniform Guard, a military secret police, but he trusted eunuchs, who had helped him during the civil war, even more.

In 1420 he set up the Eastern Depot, named for its office near the east gate of the palace in Beijing. Run by a senior eunuch, it watched officials, opened cases, made arrests and reported directly to the emperor, outside the normal courts. Later emperors added a Western Depot in 1477, briefly. Under powerful eunuchs such as Wei Zhongxian in the 1620s, the depot became a byword for torture and terror.
story_zh: 永乐帝以武力夺得皇位，担心忠于建文帝的官员暗中图谋。他已经有了由军人组成的特务机构锦衣卫，但他更信任在靖难之役中出过力的宦官。
1420年，他设立东厂，因衙门设在北京东安门附近而得名。东厂由一名高级宦官掌管，负责监视官员、侦办案件、逮捕人犯，直接向皇帝报告，不受正常司法机构的约束。1477年还一度增设西厂。到了17世纪20年代魏忠贤专权时，东厂成了酷刑和恐怖的代名词。
eastern-depot.why: The depot gave eunuchs a powerful tool in Ming politics and became a symbol of the dynasty's harsh, secretive rule.
eastern-depot.why_zh: 东厂使宦官在明朝政治中握有了一件利器，也成为明代严酷而隐秘的统治的象征。

story: Beijing had been Zhu Di's base as Prince of Yan, and it was close to the Mongol frontier he wanted to watch. Soon after taking the throne he renamed Beiping as Beijing, the 'northern capital'. From 1406, and in earnest from 1417, hundreds of thousands of workers built a new palace there, with timber floated from the forests of Sichuan and Yunnan and stone from nearby quarries.

The Forbidden City was finished in 1420, and in 1421 Beijing officially became the main capital, with Nanjing kept as a secondary capital. Only months later, lightning set fire to three of the main halls. The Grand Canal, rebuilt in 1415, carried grain from the south to feed the new capital.
story_zh: 北京原是朱棣做燕王时的根据地，又靠近他想要严加防范的蒙古边境。即位后不久，他把北平改名为北京。从1406年起，特别是1417年以后，几十万工匠民夫在这里营建新宫殿，木料从四川、云南的深山里顺水运来，石料取自附近的采石场。
紫禁城于1420年建成，1421年北京正式成为京师，南京改为留都。没过几个月，三大殿就遭雷击起火焚毁。1415年重新疏通的大运河，把南方的粮食源源不断地运到新都。
beijing-capital.why: Beijing remained China's capital for most of the next six centuries, and the Forbidden City is the largest surviving palace complex in the world.
beijing-capital.why_zh: 此后六百年间，北京大部分时间都是中国的首都。紫禁城是世界上现存规模最大的宫殿建筑群。

story: In 1449 the Oirat Mongol leader Esen attacked the Ming frontier after a dispute over tribute trade. The 22-year-old Zhengtong Emperor, urged on by the powerful eunuch Wang Zhen, decided to lead a large army against him in person, against the advice of his ministers.

The campaign was badly organized. On the way back the army camped at Tumu, a post station without water, and was surrounded. The Oirats destroyed it, Wang Zhen was killed, and the emperor was captured. In Beijing, the vice minister of war Yu Qian refused calls to flee south. He put the emperor's brother on the throne as the Jingtai Emperor and organized the defense. When Esen reached Beijing in October, he was beaten back.
story_zh: 1449年，瓦剌首领也先因朝贡贸易发生纠纷，率军进犯明朝边境。二十二岁的明英宗在权宦王振的怂恿下，不顾大臣劝阻，决定亲自率大军出征。
这次出征组织混乱。回师途中，大军在缺水的土木堡扎营，被瓦剌军包围，全军覆没，王振被杀，英宗被俘。消息传到北京，兵部侍郎于谦坚决反对南迁，拥立英宗的弟弟即位，是为景泰帝，并组织京城防务。10月也先兵临北京城下，被明军击退。
tumu.why: The disaster ended Ming attempts to conquer the steppe and turned its frontier policy to defense, leading to the great Ming Great Wall.
tumu.why_zh: 土木之变后，明朝放弃了进攻草原的打算，边防转为守势，后来大规模修建长城便由此而来。

story: After his capture at Tumu, the Zhengtong Emperor was sent back by the Oirats in 1450. His brother, the Jingtai Emperor, did not give him back the throne. Instead he kept him under house arrest in the Southern Palace for seven years, and replaced Zhengtong's son as heir with his own son, who soon died.

Early in 1457 Jingtai fell seriously ill and had no heir. On the night of 11 February, the general Shi Heng, the eunuch Cao Jixiang and the official Xu Youzhen led troops into the palace, broke down the gate of the Southern Palace and placed the former emperor on the throne at dawn. He took a new reign name, Tianshun. Yu Qian, the hero of 1449, was accused of treason and executed.
story_zh: 土木之变中被俘的明英宗于1450年被瓦剌放回。他的弟弟景泰帝没有把皇位还给他，而是把他软禁在南宫七年，还废掉英宗的儿子，改立自己的儿子为太子，可太子不久就夭折了。
1457年初，景泰帝病重，又没有继承人。2月11日夜里，将领石亨、宦官曹吉祥和官员徐有贞带兵进宫，撞开南宫大门，拥英宗在黎明时重登皇位，改元天顺。1449年保卫北京的功臣于谦被诬谋逆，惨遭杀害。
duomen-coup.why: The coup showed how court factions could make and unmake emperors, and Yu Qian's death became one of the great injustices remembered in Chinese history.
duomen-coup.why_zh: 夺门之变说明朝中派系可以左右皇位。于谦之死成为中国历史上著名的冤案之一。

story: Wang Shouren, known as Wang Yangming, was a scholar-official who had long tried to follow Zhu Xi's teaching that one must study external things to understand their principle. As a young man he once spent seven days staring at bamboo to grasp its principle, and fell ill.

In 1506 he defended officials who criticized the powerful eunuch Liu Jin. He was flogged and exiled to Longchang, a remote post station in the mountains of Guizhou. Living among local people in hard conditions, he reflected on life and death. One night in 1508 he suddenly realized that the way of the sage is complete in one's own nature, and that seeking principle in external things had been a mistake. He soon taught that knowledge and action are one.
story_zh: 王守仁，号阳明，长期按照朱熹"格物致知"的教导，试图从外物中探求道理。年轻时他曾对着竹子"格"了七天，想弄懂竹子的道理，结果病倒了。
1506年，他上疏营救弹劾权宦刘瑾的官员，被廷杖后贬到贵州深山中的龙场驿当驿丞。他在艰苦的环境中与当地百姓相处，反复思考生死问题。1508年的一天夜里，他忽然领悟：圣人之道就在自己的本性之中，过去向外物求理是错的。不久，他又提出了"知行合一"的主张。
longchang.why: Wang Yangming's 'learning of the mind' became the most influential challenge to Zhu Xi's orthodoxy and later inspired thinkers and reformers in China and Japan.
longchang.why_zh: 王阳明的心学成为对朱熹正统理学最有力的挑战，后来深刻影响了中国和日本的思想家与改革者。

quote.zh: 始知圣人之道，吾性自足，向之求理于事物者误也。
quote.en: Only then did I know that the way of the sage is complete within my own nature, and that seeking principle in things had been a mistake.
quote.from: Chronological Biography of Wang Yangming 王阳明年谱

story: The Zhengde Emperor died in 1521 without a son. Senior officials led by Grand Secretary Yang Tinghe chose his cousin, a 14-year-old prince from Anlu in Hubei, as the new emperor. They insisted that the boy be treated as the adopted son of Zhengde's father and call his own father only 'uncle'.

The Jiajing Emperor refused. He wanted to honor his real father and mother as emperor and empress. The quarrel lasted three years, and some lower officials took the emperor's side to win promotion. In 1524 more than two hundred officials knelt and wailed outside the palace gate in protest. Jiajing had them arrested, and over a hundred were flogged in court; about seventeen died. Yang Tinghe had already been forced to retire.
story_zh: 1521年，明武宗正德帝去世，没有儿子。以内阁首辅杨廷和为首的大臣们选定他的堂弟、湖北安陆的十四岁藩王继位。大臣们坚持要新皇帝过继给正德帝的父亲孝宗为子，对自己的生父只能称"皇叔父"。
嘉靖帝不肯，他要尊自己的亲生父母为皇帝、皇后。争论持续了三年，一些中下级官员为求升迁而站在皇帝一边。1524年，两百多名官员跪在左顺门外痛哭抗议。嘉靖帝下令逮捕，一百多人受廷杖，约十七人被打死。杨廷和此前已被迫退休。
great-rites.why: Jiajing won and learned he could crush his officials. The fight poisoned relations between the throne and the bureaucracy for decades.
great-rites.why_zh: 嘉靖帝获胜，也由此知道自己可以压服群臣。这场争斗使君臣关系恶化了几十年。

story: Altan Khan of the Tümed Mongols had become the strongest leader on the Ming's northern frontier. He repeatedly asked to trade horses for Chinese goods at border markets. The Jiajing court refused, and Altan's raids grew larger.

In 1550, the gengxu year, Altan's horsemen broke through the Great Wall at Gubeikou and rode to the outskirts of Beijing. For about a week they looted and burned villages around the capital. Ming troops gathered in the city but did not go out to fight; the chief grand secretary Yan Song reportedly said that the raiders would leave once they had enough loot. Eventually they did. The minister of war, Ding Ruxia, was executed as a scapegoat.
story_zh: 土默特部的俺答汗成了明朝北部边境上最强大的蒙古首领。他多次要求在边境开设马市，用马匹换取中原物资，嘉靖朝廷一再拒绝，俺答的劫掠也越来越频繁。
1550年，即庚戌年，俺答率骑兵从古北口突破长城，直抵北京城郊，在京城周围烧杀抢掠了约一个星期。明军聚集城中，却不敢出战。据说内阁首辅严嵩认为，敌人抢够了自然会走。后来蒙古军果然满载而去，兵部尚书丁汝夔被当作替罪羊处死。
gengxu-raid.why: The raid exposed the Ming's weakness and pushed the court toward building stronger walls and, two decades later, toward making peace and opening trade.
gengxu-raid.why_zh: 这次劫掠暴露了明朝的虚弱，促使朝廷加固长城，二十年后又转而议和通商。

story: Before dawn on 23 January 1556, a huge earthquake struck the Wei River valley in Shaanxi, with its center near Huazhou. Its strength is estimated at around magnitude 8. Damage spread across Shaanxi, Shanxi, Henan and beyond, and city walls and temples collapsed hundreds of kilometers away.

Official records report that about 830,000 people died, making it the deadliest earthquake known. Many people in the region lived in yaodong, homes dug into the soft loess cliffs, which collapsed and buried whole families. Others were killed by landslides and fires. A local scholar who survived, Qin Keda, wrote afterwards that people should not rush outside during a quake but crouch and wait, advice still repeated today.
story_zh: 1556年1月23日凌晨，陕西渭河流域发生特大地震，震中在华州一带，估计震级约为8级。陕西、山西、河南等地都受到波及，几百公里外的城墙和寺庙也有倒塌。
据官方记载，约八十三万人在地震中丧生，这是已知死亡人数最多的一次地震。当地很多人住在黄土崖上挖出的窑洞里，窑洞坍塌，常常整家人被埋。还有许多人死于山崩和火灾。幸存的当地学者秦可大事后写道，地震时不要急着往外跑，应当就地蹲伏等待，这个建议今天仍有人提起。
shaanxi-earthquake.why: The disaster shows how dangerous building methods can make an earthquake far deadlier, a lesson that still shapes earthquake safety.
shaanxi-earthquake.why_zh: 这场灾难说明，房屋的建造方式会让地震的伤亡成倍增加，这一教训至今仍影响着防震工作。

people.name: Qin Keda
people.role: Survivor who wrote about the quake

story: Portuguese ships first reached the south China coast around 1513. Early relations went badly: the Ming fought and expelled them in the 1520s and banned trade. But Portuguese merchants kept trading along the coast, often illegally, and Chinese officials saw profit in a controlled arrangement.

In the 1550s local officials in Guangdong allowed the Portuguese to dry their goods on the Macau peninsula, and by 1557 they had settled there. They paid fees and later a yearly ground rent, while the Ming kept a wall and customs post at the isthmus. Macau prospered by carrying Chinese silk to Japan and Japanese silver back to China. It also became the base from which Jesuit missionaries entered China.
story_zh: 葡萄牙船只约在1513年首次抵达中国南方沿海。双方最初关系很差，明朝在16世纪20年代与葡萄牙人交战，将其驱逐，并禁止贸易。但葡萄牙商人仍在沿海偷偷做生意，地方官员也看到了有节制的通商可以带来好处。
16世纪50年代，广东地方官允许葡萄牙人在澳门半岛晾晒货物，到1557年他们已在此定居。葡萄牙人缴纳税费，后来每年交地租，明朝则在半岛连接陆地的地方设关闸管控。澳门靠把中国丝绸运往日本、再把日本白银运回中国而兴旺起来，也成为耶稣会传教士进入中国的基地。
macau.why: Macau was the first lasting European foothold in China and stayed under Portuguese administration until 1999.
macau.why_zh: 澳门是欧洲人在中国最早的长期据点，一直由葡萄牙管治到1999年。

story: In the mid-1500s the coasts of Zhejiang and Fujian suffered constant raids by wokou, 'Japanese pirates'. Many were in fact Chinese smugglers who traded illegally under the Ming sea ban, joined by Japanese and others. The regular coastal troops were poorly trained and often ran away.

The general Qi Jiguang recruited a new army of tough farmers and miners from Yiwu in Zhejiang. He drilled them hard and taught a 'mandarin duck formation', a small team of twelve that combined shields, long bamboo spears and other weapons to work together. In 1561, when a large pirate force attacked Taizhou, Qi's army won nine battles in about a month. He went on to clear the pirates from Fujian with Yu Dayou.
story_zh: 16世纪中叶，浙江、福建沿海倭寇横行。所谓倭寇，其实很多是在海禁之下走私的中国海商，此外也有日本人和其他人。沿海的官军训练松弛，常常一触即溃。
将领戚继光在浙江义乌招募吃苦耐劳的农民和矿工，组建新军，严加训练，并创立"鸳鸯阵"：十二人为一队，盾牌、狼筅、长枪等兵器相互配合。1561年大批倭寇进犯台州，戚家军在一个月左右的时间里九战九捷。此后他又与俞大猷一起肃清了福建的倭寇。
taizhou-wokou.why: Qi Jiguang became a model Chinese general, and his training manuals were studied for centuries. The pirate crisis also helped push the Ming to relax its sea ban.
taizhou-wokou.why_zh: 戚继光成了中国将领的典范，他的兵书被后人研读了几百年。倭患也促使明朝放宽了海禁。

story: Since its early years the Ming had banned private sea trade, allowing foreign goods only through official tribute missions. The ban did not stop trade; it pushed it into smuggling and helped cause the pirate crisis of the 1550s.

In 1567, at the start of the Longqing reign, the court agreed to proposals from Fujian officials. Private merchants could now get licenses to sail from Yuegang, a small port near Zhangzhou, to Southeast Asia. Direct trade with Japan stayed banned. Four years later the Spanish founded Manila, and Chinese junks from Yuegang carried silk and porcelain there in exchange for silver mined in Mexico and Peru. Yuegang grew rich on the trade.
story_zh: 明朝建国后不久就实行海禁，只允许外国商品通过官方朝贡进入中国。海禁并没有真正禁住贸易，反而把它逼成了走私，16世纪50年代的倭患也与此有关。
1567年隆庆帝即位之初，朝廷采纳福建官员的建议，允许私人商人领取"船引"，从漳州附近的小港月港出海，前往东南亚贸易，但仍禁止直接与日本通商。四年后西班牙人建立马尼拉，从月港出发的中国商船把丝绸、瓷器运到那里，换回墨西哥和秘鲁出产的白银。月港因此繁荣起来。
longqing-trade.why: The opening linked China to the first global trade network. American silver flooded in and became the money of the late Ming economy.
longqing-trade.why_zh: 开放海禁把中国与最早的全球贸易网络连在一起。大量美洲白银流入中国，成为晚明经济中的主要货币。

story: Much of the Great Wall that visitors see today near Beijing was built in the late Ming. After the raid of 1550, the defense of the capital's northern approaches became urgent. In 1568 the famous anti-pirate general Qi Jiguang was given command of the Jizhou region, which stretched from Shanhai Pass toward Juyong Pass.

Qi found the old wall low and the soldiers poorly trained. He strengthened the wall with brick and stone and built about 1,200 hollow watchtowers, two- or three-story brick towers where soldiers could live, store weapons and fire on attackers. He also brought in drilled troops from Zhejiang and trained the local garrison. During his sixteen years in command, the Mongols made no major breakthrough in his sector.
story_zh: 今天人们在北京附近看到的长城，很多是明朝后期修建的。1550年庚戌之变后，京城北面的防务变得十分紧迫。1568年，抗倭名将戚继光奉命镇守蓟州，防区从山海关一直延伸到居庸关一带。
戚继光发现原有的城墙低矮，守军训练不足。他用砖石加固城墙，修建了约一千二百座空心敌台。这种两三层高的砖楼可以驻兵、存放武器，还能居高射击来敌。他又调来训练有素的浙江兵，整顿当地驻军。他镇守蓟州的十六年间，蒙古军始终没能在这一带大举突破。
qi-great-wall.why: Qi's towers and brick walls at places like Jinshanling and Mutianyu are the classic image of the Great Wall.
qi-great-wall.why_zh: 金山岭、慕田峪等地的敌台和砖墙，就是今天人们心中长城的经典形象。

story: In 1570 Altan Khan's grandson, Bagha Ejei, quarreled with his grandfather and fled to the Ming at Datong. Instead of using him as a hostage for war, the Ming governor Wang Chonggu and grand secretaries Gao Gong and Zhang Juzheng saw a chance for peace.

They returned the grandson in exchange for Chinese defectors living with Altan. In 1571 the Ming named Altan 'Shunyi Wang', the 'Obedient and Righteous Prince', and opened regular horse markets along the border. Raids almost stopped, and trade at the markets grew every year. Altan built a city that the Ming named Guihua, today's Hohhot. In 1578 he met the Tibetan lama Sonam Gyatso and gave him the title Dalai Lama.
story_zh: 1570年，俺答汗的孙子把汉那吉与祖父不和，投奔大同的明军。宣大总督王崇古和内阁大学士高拱、张居正没有把他当作打仗的人质，而是看到了议和的机会。
明朝把把汉那吉送回，换回投奔俺答的汉人叛逃者。1571年，明朝封俺答为"顺义王"，在边境开设定期马市，此后边境劫掠几乎停止，互市贸易逐年兴旺。俺答修建了一座城，明朝赐名归化，就是今天的呼和浩特。1578年，他会见西藏的索南嘉措喇嘛，赠给他"达赖喇嘛"的称号。
altan-peace.why: The settlement brought decades of peace on the northern frontier and spread Tibetan Buddhism among the Mongols.
altan-peace.why_zh: 这次和议给北部边境带来了几十年的和平，也使藏传佛教在蒙古人中传播开来。

story: Li Shizhen was born in 1518 into a family of doctors in Qizhou, Hubei. After failing the provincial exams three times, he turned to medicine. He found that the old books on medicinal substances were full of errors and confusion, and set out to write a new one.

For 27 years he read hundreds of earlier works, traveled through the mountains to collect plants and minerals, and talked to farmers, hunters and fishermen. He finished the Compendium of Materia Medica in 1578, after rewriting it three times. It describes about 1,900 drugs from plants, animals and minerals, with more than 11,000 prescriptions and over a thousand illustrations. It was printed in Nanjing only after his death in 1593.
story_zh: 李时珍1518年出生在湖北蕲州的一个医生家庭。他三次乡试落第，转而专心行医。他发现过去的本草书中错误和混乱很多，决心重新编写一部。
二十七年间，他研读了数百种前人著作，翻山越岭采集药物标本，还向农民、猎人和渔夫请教。1578年，他三易其稿，终于完成《本草纲目》。书中收录植物、动物、矿物药约一千九百种，附方一万一千多个，插图一千多幅。直到他1593年去世后，这部书才在南京刊印。
bencao-gangmu.why: The Compendium is the most complete book of traditional Chinese medicine and was translated into many languages; Charles Darwin cited it as an 'ancient Chinese encyclopedia'.
bencao-gangmu.why_zh: 《本草纲目》是中国传统医药学最完备的著作，被译成多种文字，达尔文也曾称引这部"中国古代的百科全书"。

story: Ming taxes were complicated. Households paid a land tax in grain or cloth, and also owed labor service, from carrying goods to working in government offices. Rich families with connections often avoided their share, while the burden fell on the poor. From the early 1500s some local officials, such as Hai Rui, tried combining these duties into one payment in silver.

Zhang Juzheng, the senior grand secretary who ran the government for the young Wanli Emperor, ordered a new national survey of farmland from 1578. In 1581 he extended the 'single whip' method across the empire. Most land taxes and labor services were added together and paid in silver, assessed mainly on land. The reform raised revenue and cut corruption, and the treasury filled up.
story_zh: 明朝的赋税十分繁杂。百姓除了用粮食或布帛缴纳田赋，还要承担各种徭役，从运送物资到在衙门里当差都有。有权势的富户常常设法逃避，负担便落到穷人头上。16世纪初起，海瑞等一些地方官就开始尝试把各项赋役合并成一笔，用白银缴纳。
辅佐年幼的万历帝主持朝政的内阁首辅张居正，从1578年起下令在全国重新丈量土地。1581年，他把一条鞭法推行到全国：把田赋和大部分徭役合并，主要按田亩折成白银征收。改革增加了国家收入，减少了贪污，国库也充实起来。
single-whip.why: The reform made silver the basis of state finance and was the most important tax change of the Ming. Its logic carried on into the Qing.
single-whip.why_zh: 一条鞭法使白银成为国家财政的基础，是明代最重要的赋税改革，其思路也被清朝继承。

people.name: Hai Rui
people.role: Official who tried the method locally

story: In the 7th century the monk Xuanzang traveled from Chang'an to India and back to bring Buddhist scriptures to China. Over the following centuries, storytellers and playwrights turned his journey into a fantastic adventure with magical companions.

In 1592 the Shidetang publishing house in Nanjing printed a 100-chapter novel that brought these tales together. The monk Tripitaka travels west guarded by three disciples: Sun Wukong, the rebellious Monkey King born from a stone; Zhu Bajie, a greedy pig; and the quiet Sha Wujing. They face eighty-one ordeals and countless demons before reaching the Buddha. The book was published anonymously. Since the 1920s it has usually been credited to Wu Cheng'en.
story_zh: 7世纪时，玄奘从长安出发前往印度，取回佛经。此后几百年间，说书人和剧作家把他的经历演绎成一个充满神魔色彩的冒险故事。
1592年，南京的世德堂书坊刊印了一部一百回的小说，把这些故事集于一书。唐僧在三个徒弟的护送下西行：从石头里蹦出来、桀骜不驯的美猴王孙悟空，贪吃好色的猪八戒，还有老实寡言的沙僧。师徒历经九九八十一难，降伏无数妖魔，终于到达灵山。此书刊行时没有署名，20世纪20年代以来一般认为作者是吴承恩。
journey-to-the-west.why: Journey to the West is one of the Four Great Classical Novels of Chinese literature. The Monkey King is one of the best-loved figures in East Asian culture.
journey-to-the-west.why_zh: 《西游记》是中国古典四大名著之一，孙悟空是东亚文化中最受喜爱的人物之一。

people.name: Xuanzang
people.role: Tang monk whose journey inspired it

story: In 1592 the Japanese ruler Toyotomi Hideyoshi, who had just unified Japan, invaded Korea as the first step toward conquering China. His armies took Seoul and Pyongyang within weeks. The Korean king fled north and appealed to the Ming, Korea's overlord.

The Wanli Emperor sent an army of about 40,000 under Li Rusong across the Yalu. In February 1593 Ming and Korean forces stormed Pyongyang, using heavy cannon against the Japanese defenses. They then pushed south but were checked at Byeokjegwan near Seoul. Peace talks dragged on for years, and Hideyoshi invaded again in 1597. The war ended only after his death in 1598, when the Japanese armies went home.
story_zh: 1592年，刚刚统一日本的丰臣秀吉出兵侵略朝鲜，打算以此为跳板征服中国。日军几周之内就攻占了汉城和平壤，朝鲜国王逃往北方，向宗主国明朝求援。
万历帝派李如松率约四万大军渡过鸭绿江。1593年2月，明朝和朝鲜军队用重炮猛攻平壤，收复了这座城市。随后明军南下，在汉城附近的碧蹄馆受挫。和谈拖了好几年，1597年丰臣秀吉再次出兵。直到1598年丰臣秀吉死去，日军才撤回国内。
imjin.why: The war saved Korea but cost the Ming heavily in money and men, weakening it just as the Jurchens were rising in the northeast.
imjin.why_zh: 这场战争保住了朝鲜，但明朝耗费了大量钱粮和兵力，恰在女真于东北崛起之际元气大伤。

story: Tang Xianzu was a gifted writer from Linchuan in Jiangxi who refused to flatter the powerful chief minister Zhang Juzheng and spent years in minor posts. In 1598 he resigned as magistrate of Suichang and went home, where he finished his greatest play, The Peony Pavilion.

In 55 scenes it tells of Du Liniang, a sheltered girl who falls asleep in a garden and dreams of a young scholar, Liu Mengmei. She pines for him and dies. Three years later Liu finds her portrait and her ghost, and through the power of love she comes back to life. The play praises true feeling over strict rules, and it was performed in the elegant kunqu style.
story_zh: 汤显祖是江西临川人，才华出众，因不肯依附权相张居正，长期只做小官。1598年，他辞去遂昌知县，回到家乡，完成了他最重要的剧作《牡丹亭》。
全剧五十五出，讲的是深闺少女杜丽娘在花园中睡着，梦见书生柳梦梅，醒后相思成疾而死。三年后，柳梦梅拾到她的画像，与她的魂魄相会，杜丽娘凭着爱情的力量起死回生。这部戏歌颂真情，反对礼教的束缚，用典雅的昆曲演唱。
peony-pavilion.why: The Peony Pavilion is the most famous Chinese drama of love and is still staged today. Tang Xianzu is often compared to Shakespeare, who died the same year, 1616.
peony-pavilion.why_zh: 《牡丹亭》是中国最著名的爱情戏，至今仍在上演。汤显祖常被拿来与莎士比亚相比，两人都在1616年去世。

story: The Italian Jesuit Matteo Ricci reached Macau in 1582 and soon settled in Zhaoqing in Guangdong. He learned Chinese, studied the classics and, after some years, adopted the dress of a Confucian scholar. He made friends with officials by showing them European maps, clocks, prisms and mathematics.

After nearly twenty years of trying, he reached Beijing in 1601 and presented the Wanli Emperor with chiming clocks and a clavichord. He was allowed to stay in the capital. There he published a large world map that showed the Chinese the Americas, wrote books on Christianity in Chinese and worked with scholars such as Xu Guangqi. When he died in 1610, the emperor granted land for his tomb in Beijing.
story_zh: 意大利耶稣会士利玛窦1582年来到澳门，不久定居广东肇庆。他学习汉语，研读儒家经典，几年后改穿儒服。他向官员们展示欧洲的地图、钟表、三棱镜和数学，结交了不少朋友。
经过近二十年的努力，他在1601年进入北京，向万历帝进献自鸣钟和古钢琴，获准留居京城。他在北京刊印了大幅世界地图，让中国人第一次看到美洲，还用中文写作介绍基督教的书籍，并与徐光启等学者合作。1610年他去世后，皇帝特地赐地在北京安葬。
ricci.why: Ricci's method of adapting to Chinese culture opened a long exchange of science and ideas between China and Europe.
ricci.why_zh: 利玛窦适应中国文化的传教方式，开启了中欧之间长期的科学与思想交流。

story: Xu Guangqi, a scholar from Shanghai, met Matteo Ricci and became a Catholic in 1603. After passing the highest examination in 1604 he worked in Beijing, where he and Ricci studied together. Xu believed that Western mathematics could help China with practical problems such as calendars, surveying and water works.

Ricci explained the Latin edition of Euclid's Elements prepared by his teacher Christopher Clavius, and Xu wrote it down in polished classical Chinese, revising it many times. In 1607 they published the first six books, on plane geometry, as Jihe Yuanben. They had to invent many terms, including the words for point, line, surface, parallel and geometry itself, which are still used today.
story_zh: 上海人徐光启结识利玛窦后，于1603年受洗加入天主教。1604年他考中进士，在北京任职，常与利玛窦一起研习学问。他认为西方数学可以帮助中国解决历法、测量和水利等实际问题。
利玛窦口述他的老师克拉维乌斯编订的拉丁文本欧几里得《原本》，徐光启用典雅的文言笔录，反复修改润色。1607年，两人刊印了讲平面几何的前六卷，书名《几何原本》。他们创造了许多译名，比如点、线、面、平行线，以及"几何"一词本身，这些词今天仍在使用。
euclid-chinese.why: The translation brought deductive proof to China and created much of the vocabulary of modern Chinese mathematics.
euclid-chinese.why_zh: 这部译著把演绎证明的方法带到中国，奠定了现代汉语数学词汇的基础。

story: Nurhaci was a chief of the Jianzhou Jurchens, who lived northeast of the Ming frontier in today's Liaoning and Jilin. In 1583 his father and grandfather were killed during a Ming attack on a rival chief. Starting with a small band, according to tradition only thirteen suits of armor, he spent thirty years uniting the Jurchen tribes by war and marriage.

He organized all his people into military and social units called banners, each with its own flag, which grew into the Eight Banners. In 1616 he proclaimed himself khan at his capital Hetu Ala and named his state Jin, recalling the Jurchen Jin dynasty; historians call it the Later Jin. In 1618 he announced 'Seven Grievances' against the Ming and went to war.
story_zh: 努尔哈赤是建州女真的首领，建州女真生活在明朝东北边外，即今天的辽宁、吉林一带。1583年，他的父亲和祖父在明军攻打另一个部落首领时被误杀。相传他以十三副遗甲起兵，用三十年时间，通过征战和联姻统一了女真各部。
他把部众编为兵民合一的"旗"，各旗以不同颜色的旗帜为标志，后来发展为八旗。1616年，他在都城赫图阿拉称汗，国号"金"，以承接当年女真人建立的金朝，史称后金。1618年，他以"七大恨"告天，起兵反明。
later-jin.why: The Later Jin became the Qing dynasty, which conquered China in 1644. The banner system held Manchu power together for nearly three centuries.
later-jin.why_zh: 后金后来改称大清，于1644年入主中原。八旗制度维系了满洲统治近三百年。

people.name: Nurhaci
people.role: Jurchen leader, founder of the Later Jin

story: After Nurhaci captured the Ming frontier town of Fushun in 1618, the court sent Yang Hao to destroy him. In the spring of 1619 Yang divided an army of around 100,000 men, with Korean allies, into four columns that marched separately toward Nurhaci's capital, Hetu Ala.

Nurhaci gathered almost all his strength and struck the columns one at a time. The western column under Du Song had crossed the river at Sarhu ahead of the others; it was destroyed and Du Song was killed. In the following days Nurhaci routed the northern column under Ma Lin and the eastern column under the veteran Liu Ting. Only the southern column escaped, after being called back. In five days the Ming lost about 45,000 men.
story_zh: 1618年努尔哈赤攻下明朝边城抚顺后，朝廷派杨镐前去征剿。1619年春，杨镐把约十万大军（另有朝鲜援军）分成四路，分头向努尔哈赤的都城赫图阿拉进发。
努尔哈赤集中几乎全部兵力，各个击破。杜松率领的西路军抢先渡河到达萨尔浒，最先被歼灭，杜松战死。此后几天，努尔哈赤又击溃了马林的北路军和老将刘綎的东路军。只有南路军因被及时召回而幸免。五天之内，明军损失约四万五千人。
sarhu.why: Sarhu turned the balance of power in the northeast. The Ming lost the initiative, and the Jurchens soon took all of Liaodong.
sarhu.why_zh: 萨尔浒之战扭转了东北的力量对比。明朝从此失去主动，后金不久便占领了整个辽东。

story: In 1604 the official Gu Xiancheng revived the Donglin Academy in Wuxi. Its scholars and their allies at court criticized corruption and the power of eunuchs, and became known as the Donglin party. Under the Tianqi Emperor, who preferred carpentry to government, the eunuch Wei Zhongxian took control of the court.

In 1624 the censor Yang Lian accused Wei of 24 great crimes. Wei struck back. In 1625 Yang Lian, Zuo Guangdou and four others were thrown into the prison of the Embroidered Uniform Guard and tortured to death. More arrests followed in 1626, and in Suzhou crowds rioted to protect one of the accused. Donglin academies were destroyed, while officials built shrines to Wei and hailed him as 'nine thousand years old'.
story_zh: 1604年，顾宪成在无锡重建东林书院。书院的学者和他们在朝中的同道抨击贪腐和宦官专权，被称为东林党。天启帝喜欢做木匠活，不理朝政，宦官魏忠贤趁机把持了朝廷。
1624年，左副都御史杨涟上疏弹劾魏忠贤二十四大罪。魏忠贤展开报复：1625年，杨涟、左光斗等六人被投入锦衣卫诏狱，酷刑致死。1626年又有一批人被捕，苏州百姓为保护被捕者聚众抗争。东林书院被拆毁，各地官员却竞相为魏忠贤建生祠，称他"九千岁"。
donglin-purge.why: The purge gutted the Ming government just as it faced the Manchus and famine. The new Chongzhen Emperor drove Wei to suicide in 1627, but factional hatred never ended.
donglin-purge.why_zh: 这场清洗在明朝面临后金威胁和饥荒的关头重创了朝廷。1627年崇祯帝即位，逼魏忠贤自尽，但党争从此再未平息。

story: After the Later Jin took Liaodong in 1621, most Ming officials wanted to pull back to Shanhai Pass. Yuan Chonghuan, a young official from Guangdong, argued for holding the corridor beyond the pass and rebuilt the walls of Ningyuan. When his superior ordered a retreat in 1626, Yuan refused to leave.

In February 1626 Nurhaci attacked Ningyuan with a large army. Yuan had only about 10,000 men, but he had several large 'red barbarian' cannon, copies of European guns bought through Macau. He burned the houses outside the walls, brought everyone inside and fired the cannon from the walls. The Jin assaults failed with heavy losses, and Nurhaci withdrew. He died that autumn.
story_zh: 1621年后金攻占辽东后，明朝多数官员主张退守山海关。来自广东的年轻官员袁崇焕却主张坚守关外的走廊地带，并重修了宁远城墙。1626年他的上司下令撤退，袁崇焕拒不从命。
1626年2月，努尔哈赤率大军围攻宁远。袁崇焕手下只有约一万人，但城上有数门从澳门购得、仿照欧洲制造的"红夷大炮"。他烧掉城外房屋，把百姓全部撤进城内，在城头开炮迎敌。后金军屡攻不下，伤亡惨重，努尔哈赤只得撤兵，当年秋天就去世了。
ningyuan.why: Ningyuan was the first Ming victory over the Jurchens and showed the value of European cannon, which both sides then raced to acquire.
ningyuan.why_zh: 宁远之战是明朝对后金的第一次胜利，也显示了西洋火炮的威力，此后双方都竞相引进大炮。

story: In the late 1620s northern Shaanxi suffered years of drought and famine during a period of unusually cold weather. People ate bark and even soil. Yet tax collectors still demanded payment, and the government cut costs by laying off postal workers and failing to pay frontier soldiers.

In 1628 starving peasants, deserters and unpaid soldiers rose in several counties of northern Shaanxi. Bands led by men such as Wang Jiayin and Gao Yingxiang, the 'Dashing King', moved from place to place, looting and recruiting. Among those who joined were Li Zicheng, a laid-off postal worker, and Zhang Xianzhong, a former soldier. The government swung between crushing and pardoning the rebels, and the movement kept growing.
story_zh: 17世纪20年代末，正值气候异常寒冷的时期，陕北连年大旱，饥民吃树皮、甚至吃观音土。可是官府照样催逼赋税，朝廷为了节省开支，又裁撤驿卒，拖欠边兵的军饷。
1628年，饥民、逃兵和欠饷的士兵在陕北多个县起事。王嘉胤、"闯王"高迎祥等人率领的队伍流动作战，四处劫掠，不断扩充人马。被裁撤的驿卒李自成和当过兵的张献忠也先后加入。朝廷时剿时抚，起义却越来越壮大。
shaanxi-revolts.why: These revolts grew into the great rebellions that destroyed the Ming in 1644.
shaanxi-revolts.why_zh: 这些民变后来发展成大规模的农民起义，最终在1644年推翻了明朝。

story: After his victories at Ningyuan, Yuan Chonghuan promised the new Chongzhen Emperor that he would recover Liaodong within five years. In 1629 he executed Mao Wenlong, an independent-minded Ming commander on an island off Korea, without the emperor's permission.

Late in 1629 Hong Taiji, Nurhaci's son, avoided Yuan's fortified line by leading his army through Mongol lands and broke through the Great Wall to approach Beijing. Yuan raced back and fought outside the city walls. But rumors spread that he had let the enemy in, and Hong Taiji is said to have planted false evidence of a secret deal. Chongzhen had Yuan arrested. In 1630 he was executed by slow slicing in Beijing.
story_zh: 宁远大捷后，袁崇焕向新即位的崇祯帝许诺五年平定辽东。1629年，他未经皇帝批准，擅自斩杀了驻守朝鲜附近海岛、不听节制的明将毛文龙。
1629年底，努尔哈赤之子皇太极避开袁崇焕的防线，率军绕道蒙古，突破长城，直逼北京。袁崇焕急忙回援，在城外与后金军作战。可是城中谣言四起，说是他引敌入关；据说皇太极还故意设下反间计，伪造他与后金私下议和的证据。崇祯帝下令将他逮捕，1630年在北京以凌迟处死。
yuan-chonghuan.why: Yuan's execution robbed the Ming of its ablest frontier commander. The Qianlong Emperor later declared him innocent.
yuan-chonghuan.why_zh: 处死袁崇焕使明朝失去了最有能力的边关统帅。后来乾隆帝为他平反。

story: Song Yingxing passed the provincial exam in 1615 but failed the highest exam six times. He gave up and in 1634 became an education official in Fenyi county, Jiangxi. There he wrote down what he had seen of how things are made, because he believed scholars knew too little about the work that fed and clothed them.

Tiangong Kaiwu, 'The Exploitation of the Works of Nature', was published in 1637. Its 18 chapters cover growing and processing rice and wheat, silk and cotton, salt and sugar, pottery, casting bronze and iron, boats and carts, weapons, ink, paper and more, with over a hundred woodcut illustrations. The book was soon forgotten in China but survived in Japan, and was rediscovered in the 1920s.
story_zh: 宋应星1615年考中举人，此后六次参加会试都没有考中。他放弃科举，1634年到江西分宜县担任教谕。在那里，他把自己见过的各种生产技术记录下来，因为他觉得读书人对养活他们的农工百业知道得太少。
《天工开物》于1637年刊行。全书十八卷，记载了稻麦的种植和加工、养蚕和纺织、制盐和制糖、制陶、铸铜冶铁、造船造车、兵器、制墨、造纸等，配有一百多幅木刻插图。这部书在中国很快失传，却在日本保存下来，20世纪20年代才被重新发现。
tiangong-kaiwu.why: Tiangong Kaiwu is the best record of Chinese technology before the modern age and is often called an encyclopedia of Chinese crafts.
tiangong-kaiwu.why_zh: 《天工开物》是记录中国近代以前生产技术最完整的著作，被誉为"中国17世纪的工艺百科全书"。

story: By 1640 Li Zicheng's army, nearly destroyed a few years earlier, had recovered in Henan, where famine had driven huge numbers of people to join him. Scholars such as Li Yan reportedly helped him win support with slogans promising equal land and no grain tax. A popular song urged people to welcome the Dashing King and pay no tax.

In early 1641 he captured Luoyang. The city was home to Zhu Changxun, Prince of Fu, the Wanli Emperor's favorite son, famous for his enormous wealth while people starved. Li's men killed the prince. Li opened the prince's granaries and gave the grain and money to the hungry. His army grew to hundreds of thousands.
story_zh: 到1640年，几年前几乎全军覆没的李自成在河南重新壮大起来，当地饥荒严重，大批饥民投奔了他。据说李岩等读书人帮他提出"均田免粮"等口号，赢得民心。当时流传着"迎闯王，不纳粮"的歌谣。
1641年初，李自成攻克洛阳。洛阳是万历帝最宠爱的儿子、福王朱常洵的封地。福王富可敌国，百姓却在挨饿。李自成杀死福王，打开王府粮仓，把粮食和钱财分给饥民，队伍迅速扩大到几十万人。
luoyang-1641.why: The fall of Luoyang made Li Zicheng the strongest rebel in China. Three years later he took Beijing and ended the Ming.
luoyang-1641.why_zh: 攻克洛阳使李自成成为全国最强大的起义军。三年后，他攻入北京，推翻了明朝。
